description: This Java class defines a Liquibase custom changelog task that manages the creation of true/false concepts and updates observational data accordingly, specifically for the OpenMRS healthcare system. It handles concept creation, global property setup, and observation updates related to boolean concepts.

classes.name: BooleanConceptChangeSet
classes.description: A custom Liquibase change set class for creating boolean concepts, setting global properties, and updating existing observations to use these concepts within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main change operation including finding or creating true/false concepts, setting global properties, and transforming existing observation values.

methods.name: findConceptByName
methods.description: Searches for a concept matching provided locale-based names within the database.

methods.name: createConcept
methods.description: Creates a new concept with given names in different locales and inserts necessary related records.

methods.name: changeObs
methods.description: Updates observation records to replace numerical boolean values with coded concept references.

methods.name: createGlobalProperties
methods.description: Inserts global properties `Concept.true` and `Concept.false` with respective concept IDs.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Executes an SQL query to retrieve an integer result.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation message indicating completion of the boolean concepts creation process.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets the resource accessor, not utilized in this implementation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the change set, currently returns no validation errors.
